evidence: In-line handheld vacuum body featuring gold cyclone cones, purple rear filter housing, and a red finger trigger beneath the handle grip.

candidate_checks.evidence: The V12 Detect Slim uses a top-mounted push-button power switch rather than the visible red handle trigger.
The V8 family features a perpendicular bin and cyclone assembly rather than an in-line motor and filter layout.
The in-line body layout with gold cyclone cones, purple filter housing, and red finger trigger matches the V15 Detect.
The Big Ball is a canister cylinder vacuum rather than a stick vacuum handheld unit.
The V16 has a different body and handle silhouette with a CleanCompaktor mechanism.
The WashG1 is an upright wet floor cleaner with water tanks and a tall loop handle.
